source.name: HGNC complete gene set
source.note: HGNC's own bulk cross-reference file, updated by HGNC every Tuesday and Friday; ensembl_gene_id and uniprot_ids columns reflect whatever Ensembl/UniProt release HGNC had last synced against as of the download date above, not a separately pinned Ensembl release number -- HGNC does not publish one alongside this file. Ensembl gene IDs (ENSG...) are themselves stable across releases for genes that aren't renamed/merged/split, which covers the overwhelming majority of this mapping.

resolution_method: exact symbol match first; falls back to HGNC alias_symbol/prev_symbol only when the feature-space symbol has no direct current-symbol match; a fallback is accepted only if all matching HGNC rows agree on the same Ensembl gene ID, otherwise recorded as ambiguous with every candidate HGNC ID listed in gene_id_map_v1.tsv's ambiguous_candidates column
